content.value: Consider the items: 77, 33, 44, 11, 88, 22, 66, and 55. Now you have to choose a sorting algorithm between Insertion sort and Selection sort algorithm to sort the numbers. In case of choosing the algorithm, you must consider the time complexity for all cases. Now, explain your answer why you choose the certain algorithm and show the sorting steps graphically.
